title: 第011章 融合天赋外出第012章 绿色品质黑狗直接拿下
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
“竟然出了天赋？”
他眼中顿时浮现出一抹惊喜。
这可是天赋！
材料、符纸、感悟再好，终究还需要拿来使用。
可天赋一旦融合进身体，那就是自己的东西。
尤其是夜视。
对寻常人来说，这天赋未必有多惊人。
可他是茅山弟子。
以后夜里抓鬼、走坟地、探荒宅、下墓穴，这双眼睛能派上的用场太大了。
有时候提前看清一寸，命就多一分把握。
苏辰没有犹豫，向着白色光团一招手，那团白色光芒便没入他的眉心。
下一刻，苏辰双眼微微一热。
热流从眼眶深处散开，像一条条细小温蛇，在眼珠周围缓缓游走。
那感觉并不疼，反倒带着一股说不出的舒服。
苏辰闭上眼，静静感受着这股变化。
热流从眼底钻入，又沿着眼角、眉骨、太阳穴慢慢绕了一圈。
片刻后，那股温热感渐渐散去。
他重新睁眼。
眼前的草地、石槽、溪水、灌木，一下子清楚了不少。
草叶边缘的细小锯齿，溪水里游过的小虫，远处树干上的裂纹，都比刚才分明许多。

苏辰抬手在眼前晃了晃，目光微动。
“白天都能增强视线，到了晚上，效果应该更明显。”
“等入夜之后，再试一试。”
他压下心头喜意，转而看向报晓雄鸡那边返还出来的光团。
先取食饵感悟。
那团淡黄色光芒入手之后，直接化作一道细流钻进脑海。
大量念头随之散开。
糯米、豆粉、药渣、兽骨粉、鸡血、狗血、灵草碎末......
各种材料如何搭配，如何蒸煮，如何晒干，如何配比熬制......
效果肯定比不过正经丹药，可它胜在温和，没有丹毒，能长期服用。
日积月累下来，气血、筋骨、脾胃都会跟着受益。
“好东西。”苏辰低声道，“以后炼丹不够用，食饵倒是能先顶上。而且食饵还能喂给饲养物，帮助它们成长。”
他将这份感悟压下，伸手取过黑狗牙护身符。
护身符用一枚黑狗犬牙制成，约莫半指长，牙身乌黑发亮，尖端却透着一线白。
外面缠了一圈细红绳，红绳上打着三个小结，每个结里都压着一丝淡淡灵光。
苏辰把它拿在手中，指腹轻轻摩挲。
入手微凉。
但凉意不阴，反倒有股硬邦邦的煞气。
content_en:
"You actually have a talent?"
A hint of surprise suddenly appeared in his eyes.
This is a talent!
No matter how good the materials, talismans, and insights are, they still need to be used.
But once the talent is integrated into the body, it becomes one's own.
Especially night vision.
To ordinary people, this talent may not be so amazing.
But he is a disciple of Maoshan.
In the future, these eyes will be of great use when catching ghosts at night, visiting cemeteries, exploring deserted houses, and going into crypts.
Sometimes, if you see an inch in advance, you will be more sure of your life.
Su Chen did not hesitate and waved towards the white light group, and the white light disappeared between his eyebrows.
The next moment, Su Chen's eyes heated up slightly.
The heat spread from the depths of the eye sockets, like tiny warm snakes, slowly swimming around the eyeballs.
The feeling was not painful, but rather indescribably comfortable.
Su Chen closed his eyes and quietly felt the change.
The heat penetrated from the bottom of the eyes and slowly circled along the corners of the eyes, brow bones, and temples.
After a while, the warm feeling gradually dissipated.
He opened his eyes again.
The grassland, stone troughs, streams, and shrubs in front of me suddenly became much clearer.
The tiny saw teeth on the edges of the grass blades, the bugs swimming in the stream, and the cracks on the tree trunks in the distance are all much more distinct than before.
Su Chen raised his hand and waved it in front of his eyes, his eyes moving slightly.
"It can enhance vision during the day, and the effect should be more obvious at night."
"Wait until nightfall and try again."
He suppressed the joy in his heart and turned to look at the ball of light returned by the dawn rooster.
Take the bait first to understand.
After taking possession of the pale yellow light, it directly turned into a thin stream and penetrated into the mind.
A lot of thoughts dispersed.
Glutinous rice, soy flour, medicinal residue, animal bone meal, chicken blood, dog blood, minced spiritual grass...
How to mix various materials, how to steam, how to dry, how to proportion and cook...
The effect is definitely not as good as that of regular elixirs, but it is milder, has no erysipelas, and can be taken for a long time.
Over time, qi, blood, muscles, bones, spleen and stomach will all benefit.
"Good stuff." Su Chen whispered, "In the future, if the alchemy is not enough, the bait can be used first. Moreover, the bait can also be fed to the animals to help them grow."
He suppressed this realization and reached out to take the Black Dog Tooth Amulet.
The amulet is made of a black dog canine tooth, about half a finger long. The body of the tooth is black and shiny, but there is a ray of white at the tip.
There is a thin red rope wrapped around the outside. There are three small knots on the red rope, and there is a faint aura in each knot.
Su Chen took it in his hand and rubbed it gently with his fingertips.
Start slightly cold.
But the coolness is not overcast, but there is a strong evil aura.
